text:
maggie (Product): quick sync — we need a short owners list for the packaging change rollout. specifically: metering mapping, billing pipeline wiring, quota enforcement, and contract exceptions. can each owner confirm status by EOD? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

raj (Eng): I can take metering + quota enforcement. quick Q: are we keeping the existing 'tokens' bucket or switching to 'billing_units'?

lee (Billing): We're moving to 'billing_units' to unify embeddings + text. see PR #4827 for the billing adapter. main change is multiplier per model. i'll own wiring.

raj (Eng): perfect. tagging the mapping i need — any constraints on quota semantics? hard caps or soft alerts?

sophie (Contracts): there's one enterprise customer (AcmeCorp) under a fixed-rate contract. their quota must remain a hard cap at 50M billing_units/month until renewal. no automatic overage charges. any attempt to change that needs legal sign-off and a written amendment.

raj (Eng): noted. i'll add a per-customer override table in the quota enforcer. snippet i'll use for the lookup:```sql
-- per_customer_quota lookup
SELECT cap FROM customer_quota WHERE customer_id = $1;
```

lee (Billing): that works. also adding a flag in the billing adapter so we skip metering->charge for customers with contract_exemption = true. i'll add tests.

maggie (Product): thanks. still need someone to own contract sign-off flow and the deploy gating for those customers. @sophie are you OK owning the sign-off + approval doc?

sophie (Contracts): yes, i'll prepare the amendment template and send to SE for AcmeCorp. timeline: draft by tomorrow, review Fri.

raj (Eng): on deploy gating — can we have a simple runtime toggle per-customer? i propose adding this env style config:```json
{
  "customer_overrides": {
    "acme": { "hard_cap": 50000000, "billing_exempt": true }
  }
}
```

lee (Billing): good idea. i'll make billing adapter consult that table first. i'll also add an alert if a usage spike hits 90% of cap. :rotating_light:

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: staging -> canary at 2026-03-18T14:00Z. CI: green. :white_check_mark:

maggie (Product): owner rollup -> metering/quota: raj; billing wiring + tests: lee; contracts + amendment: sophie. blockers?

raj (Eng): one small blocker — need the feature flag key from infra to gate the toggle. cc @infra to create key 'customer_quota_override'.

lee (Billing): PR references: billing #4827, adapter change in #4832. i'll ping for reviews.

sophie (Contracts): i'll attach the draft amendment in this thread once ready.

maggie (Product): awesome. next steps: everyone update their PRs and leave status comments here. i'll do a final preflight checklist tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
